titel: Introducing Say More with Dr? Sheila

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen (Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst pdst.fm) - zu wenig fuer ein Urteil, aber nicht nichts; nach 1083 Tagen in der Cloud transkribiert, statt weiter auf den Rechner zu warten - das Modell schaetzt Zeitangaben, statt sie zu messen

einzeiler: Dr. Sheila invites listeners to a new season of her unique couples therapy podcast.
kurzfassung: Dr. Sheila presents the new season of her couples therapy podcast, Say More with Dr. Sheila. She highlights typical session topics including basic disagreements, open relationships, and mother issues. The podcast features guest appearances by notable comedians and actors.
stichpunkte: Dr. Sheila introduces the new season of her couples therapy podcast, Say More with Dr. Sheila
Therapy sessions explore topics like basic disagreements and navigating open relationships
Sessions also cover letting go and dealing with maternal issues
Dr. Sheila consults her own therapist, Dr. Shelley Cavalier, for guidance
The show features a lineup of prominent guest stars including Rachel Dratch, Paul Sheer, and Maya Rudolph
Episodes are distributed by PaperKite Podcasts and available on the Odyssey App
beschreibung: In the world of feelings, there are winners and losers, and somebody has to be the judge. World-renowned, self-proclaimed couples therapist Dr? Sheila invites you to sit in on her private sessions with clients. (For legal reasons, Dr? must be said in the form of a question.) Each week, a new couple…and a new puzzle to crack. You’ll get to hear, and benefit from, many of her famous techniques as she counsels patients on overcoming disagreements, dealing with an overstepping mother-in-law, navigating open relationships, and much more. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the show, because the best way to feel better about yourself is to compare your problems to the problems of others. “Say More” features guests including Kate Berlant, Paul Scheer, June Diane Raphael, Ilana Glazer, Abbi Jacobson, Maya Rudolph, Ike Barinholtz, Jessica St. Clair, Lennon Parham, Paula Pell, Janine Brito, Jason Mantzoukas, Peter Grosz, Jean Villepique, Stephnie Weir, John Lutz, Fred Armisen, Rachel Dratch, Chris Parnell and Ana Gasteyer, and stars Amy Poehler as Dr? Sheila. Say More with Dr? Sheila premieres Thursday, September 21, 2023. Listen to and follow Say More with Dr? Sheila, an Audacy production, on the Audacy app or wherever you get your podcasts.
